## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`packages/qa/scenarios` 的一组单测（替身 `claude` 子进程那一组）现在有自己的 30 秒超时，不再用默认的 5 秒。只改测试文件，一处常量加一行。
- 为什么改：其中 `--model` 那条测试要串行启动 19 次子进程。合并队列的机器忙时每次启动要 0.2 秒以上，正好卡在 5 秒边上，把一个无关的 PR 踢出了队列。
- 风险与回滚：只影响测试的超时上限，不改任何产品代码，也不发布。回滚就是还原这一个提交。
- 先看：`packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/units.test.ts` 里新加的 `STAND_IN_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS` 和它所在的 `describe` 一行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/units.test.ts`，预期 68 条全过，`--model` 那条约 1 秒。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #32562

## What changes

The live-driver describe in `packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/units.test.ts` ("the live driver against a stand-in `claude` ...") now carries `{ timeout: STAND_IN_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS }`, a named 30 000 ms constant with a one-line comment saying why: every case in it starts a real stand-in process, one start after another, so its time is a count of process starts under CI load. No skip, no retry, no quarantine, no global vitest timeout change, and nothing under `src/**` changes.

Why the whole describe and not the one case: six of its eight cases start the stand-in (3 to 19 starts each) and had no timeout of their own. The `--model` case is the heaviest (19 starts: 5 drivers x 2 constructor probes, `--version` and `auth status`, plus 9 turns), so it hit the 5 s line first; the others share the same mechanism with less headroom to spare under a worse shard.

## Tests

Measured, three local runs each, same box, before and after (ms; box held under the shared verify lock, so these are shared-box figures):

| case | starts | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| 200 KB prompt | 3 | 138 / 155 / 142 | 147 / 131 / 186 |
| timeout kills a turn (1.2 s wait) | 3 | 1284 / 1296 / 1304 | 1300 / 1297 / 1333 |
| CLI exits without result / binary gone | 5 | 211 / 275 / 212 | 217 / 275 / 240 |
| `--author-timeout` | 4 | 178 / 183 / 181 | 180 / 169 / 191 |
| tier sizes `--max-turns` | 6 | 259 / 300 / 283 | 287 / 257 / 274 |
| `--author-max-turns` / `--ask-max-turns` | 6 | 255 / 290 / 268 | 267 / 269 / 301 |
| `--model` | 19 | 835 / 926 / 861 | 898 / 873 / 965 |

About 45 ms a start locally. Under six CPU burners on four cores the `--model` case took 2300 ms (about 120 ms a start).

The failing merge-queue job (run 43155496162, job 130975212814, Test Core 2/8) printed the same cases at 701, 1723, 1150, 773, 1217, 1048 and 5049 ms (cut off): 175 to 235 ms a start in the siblings, about 4.5x local. At that rate 19 starts is 3.3 to 4.5 s before any test overhead, so the `--model` case sat at roughly 1x headroom on that shard; 30 s is about 6x the 5049 ms it was cut off at. The siblings sat at roughly 3x to 7x headroom, the same risk at a lower level, so the describe-level budget covers them the same way.
